title: Ability minus difficulty sets the odds
hook: Two stated cases: explore the one-parameter logistic item-response rule.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the one-parameter logistic item-response rule affects the stated comparison
